acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

cleavage_agent.evidence: resuspended in 50 mM TEAB and digested overnight using trypsin (Promega; Madison, WI) at an enzyme:substrate ratio of 1:100 (37°C under 750 rpm continuous agitation).

collision_energy.evidence: For MS2 identification of peptide sequence and quantification of the TMT reporter ions, MS2 spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 50,000 after HCD fragmentation at 35% with an AGC target of 1×105 ions and a maximum injection time of 120 msec.

For MS3 quantification, MS2 spectra for identification were first acquired in the Ion Trap after CID fragmentation at 30%, for quantification 10 precursors from the MS2 scan were synchronously selected (SPS MS3) for HCD fragmentation at 55%, and the MS3 spectra was acquired in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 50,000 with an AGC of 2x105 and a maximum injection time of 120ms.

For MS3 quantification, MS2 spectra for identification were first acquired in the Ion Trap after CID fragmentation at 30%, for quantification 10 precursors from the MS2 scan were synchronously selected (SPS MS3) for HCD fragmentation at 55%, and the MS3 spectra was acquired in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 50,000 with an AGC of 2x105 and a maximum injection time of 120ms.

enrichment_method.evidence: Plasma (1 mL) from each patient was depleted using ProteoMinerTM Protein Enrichment Kit (Bio-Rad) according to the manufacturer’s instructions 28.

fractionation_method.evidence: To further decrease the complexity of the proteome, we fractionated off-line by HPLC the pooled labelled sample into 51 different fractions using hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography (HILIC) 32,33.
